name: affise-mcp-extension
description: Connect Claude to your Affise affiliate platform for advanced analytics and automation
long_description: This extension enables Claude to interact with your Affise affiliate marketing platform: explore offers, query statistics and conversions, analyse trafficback, manage partners/advertisers, generate tracking links, and run partner-side queries. Both natural-language and structured tool calls are supported.

prompts.name: analyze_offers
prompts.description: Analyze Affise offers data with expert recommendations
prompts.text: Analyse the supplied Affise offers payload and report standout offers, gaps and concrete next actions for the chosen analysis_type.

prompts.name: analyze_trafficback
prompts.description: Analyze Affise trafficback data with expert insights and optimization recommendations
prompts.text: Analyse the supplied Affise trafficback payload: rank rejection reasons, isolate the geos, partners and placements driving them, and recommend fixes.

prompts.name: analyze_conversions
prompts.description: Analyze raw Affise conversion records (output of affise_conversions_raw) — fraud review, attribution paths, partner quality, geo/tech breakdowns, payouts. Use this after fetching conversions to get an expert lens on per-event data.
prompts.text: Analyse the supplied raw Affise conversion records for fraud signals, attribution paths, partner quality, geo/tech distribution and payout accuracy.

prompts.name: analyze_stats
prompts.description: Analyze Affise statistics data with comprehensive performance insights
prompts.text: Pull Affise statistics for the requested slice and period, then interpret them: highlight movements, outliers and the metrics that explain them.

prompts.name: workflow_analysis
prompts.description: Complete workflow: search offers and analyze them step by step
prompts.text: Run the full offer workflow: search Affise offers matching the query and filters, then analyse the result set step by step.

prompts.name: auto_analysis
prompts.description: Enhanced auto-analysis: offers, stats, trafficback data with comprehensive insights
prompts.text: Fetch the requested Affise data types (offers, stats, trafficback) for the given period and filters, then produce a combined analysis.
